connector.name: Elephia
connector.registryDescription: Git for your AI's context: local-first, deterministic memory over MCP. An elephant never forgets.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package elephia. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the elephia account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ELEPHIA_DIR
env.description: Path to the context store directory (default: nearest .elephia/, else ~/.elephia/store; a legacy CONTEXTGIT_DIR or .contextgit/ store is still honored)
